headline: Tesla to Wind Down Cybertruck Production at Texas Gigafactory Next Year
summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced on X that the automaker will phase out production of the Cybertruck at its Texas Gigafactory next year.
why: Tesla is a major American electric vehicle manufacturer and a component of key stock market indexes, making its production shifts significant for investors monitoring capacity and product strategy.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Production changes at a major facility directly impact the company's product line and operational footprint.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The announcement of winding down production for a flagship model alters the company's manufacturing outlook and vehicle lineup.
